checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Crossword", the size, difficulty and category pills, a Generate button and a Daily button.
Generate on Medium opens a grid with a current-clue bar starting at "1 across" and Across and Down clue lists totalling 14 to 20 clues.
Typing a letter fills the active cell and advances to the next cell; Backspace erases and moves back.
Tab and Shift+Tab move to the next and previous clue; clicking a clue in the lists jumps to it.
Clicking the active cell toggles between Across and Down where both exist.
Check puzzle marks a wrong letter as wrong and announces it; Reveal letter marks the cell as revealed.
Reveal puzzle completes the grid and opens a dialog with Time, Letters revealed and Checks, and a New puzzle button.
Pause hides the grid; Resume shows it again.
The Daily puzzle has the same clues on every load of the same date.
A puzzle in progress is saved, listed under Saved with Resume, and resumes with its entries after a reload.
Custom with fewer than five valid words shows "Add more words" and names each bad line with the reason.
Custom builds a puzzle from the example list; it can be saved as a record, printed with an answer page, listed under Saved and played.
In print media the print view shows a blank grid with Across and Down clue lists and hides the screen UI.
A pool too narrow for the size shows "Could not build a full puzzle" with a Retry button.
At 390 px wide the grid fits the screen, clue lists sit in Across/Down tabs, and check and reveal sit under one menu button.
